question: A user asks Claude, connected via the Drive connector, to save a report Claude just generated into a specific Drive folder. What can Claude do?
options: A) Claude can save files to Drive only when code execution is separately turned on first.
B) Claude can only save generated files to the root of Drive, not a folder.
C) Claude can create folders and save Claude-generated files directly into Drive itself.
D) Claude cannot save any files to Drive, only read files already there.
correct_answers: C) Claude can create folders and save Claude-generated files directly into Drive itself.
explanations: Incorrect. Code execution is required for XLSX chat uploads, not for the Drive connector's save and folder features.
Incorrect. Folder creation and organized saving are supported, not just root-level file placement.
Correct. The Drive connector supports creating folders and saving Claude-generated files, so the report can go into the requested folder.
Incorrect. Saving generated files to Drive is an explicit connector capability beyond just reading existing files.
